scientific_integrity: The support-vertex lemma, tree high-leaf special case, domination-polynomial definition, and differential–Roman identity are acknowledged as prior work. The all-graph ESI polynomial transform is the assessed new contribution; no independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: General formulas are explicit but exponential-size neighborhood sums for unrestricted base graphs; finite enumeration is corroboration, not a proof; public-literature originality checking cannot exclude all equivalent formulations.
title: A corona transform for externally supported independence, domination, and graph differential
